title: Marketing Intern
desc:
What is the Main Aim of This Position?
We’re looking for a
Marketing Intern
for our growing organization in
Eti International.
To gain hands-on experience our interns spend
one year as team-members.
Please do not hesitate to contact us to apply if you believe this is your chance to build your career:
What We Expect from You?
Support the planning and execution of international marketing activities across markets and brands,
Contribute to market, consumer, and competitor research to identify key insights and opportunities,
Assist with brand, portfolio, and new product launch projects, including communication and packaging activities,
Coordinate with sales, agencies, and cross-functional teams to support timely project execution,
Prepare marketing reports, presentations, and performance tracking to support business decisions.
Why You?
4th year undergraduate student preferably in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or a related field,
Proficiency in MS Office applications, especially PowerPoint and Excel,
Fluent in English, both written and spoken,
Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills,
Curious, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, international environment,
Ability to commit to four or five days a week,
Based in Istanbul.
